<thought>Only carbon shows a clear multi‑peak isotopic envelope spaced by ~1 Da with decreasing intensities, which is characteristic of the natural 13C distribution. No distinct 2‑peak patterns (Cl, Br) or significant M+2 peaks (S, O) are observed, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
